data.long_meaning: A name that signifies the attainment of spiritual knowledge and insight. data.cultural_impact: The name "Irfanah" derives from the Arabic word "irfan," which means "knowledge" or "gnosis." In Islamic culture, the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom has long been highly valued. The name "Irfanah" can be seen as a symbol of the importance of spiritual learning and self-improvement within the Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Irfanah" represents the attainment of deep spiritual knowledge and insight through direct experience and communication with the Divine.
